text: City Council at its meeting on September 30, October 1 and 2, 2020, adopted, as amended Item PH16.5, headed "Improving Outcomes for Toronto Residents through Implementation of HousingTO 2020-2030". Among other things, City Council has forwarded a copy of the supplementary report (September 29, 2020) from the Executive Director, Housing Secretariat [PH16.5c], to the October 20, 2020 meeting of the Planning and Housing Committee.
The Planning and Housing Committee: 1. Received the item for information.
